title: Road Construction
statementMd:
A country has $*n*$ cities. Initially, there is no road in the country. One day, the king decides to construct some roads connecting pairs of cities. Roads can be traversed either way. He wants those roads to be constructed in such a way that it is possible to go from each city to any other city by traversing at most two roads. You are also given $*m*$ pairs of cities — roads cannot be constructed between these pairs of cities.

Your task is to construct the minimum number of roads that still satisfy the above conditions. The constraints will guarantee that this is always possible.

## Input

The first line consists of two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94f406a06721e89d57a14b6dfade59c6341e93e8.png).

Then $*m*$ lines follow, each consisting of two integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$), which means that it is not possible to construct a road connecting cities $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$. Consider the cities are numbered from 1 to $*n*$.

It is guaranteed that every pair of cities will appear at most once in the input.

## Output

You should print an integer $*s*$: the minimum number of roads that should be constructed, in the first line. Then $*s*$ lines should follow, each consisting of two integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$), which means that a road should be constructed between cities $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$.

If there are several solutions, you may print any of them.

## Note

This is one possible solution of the example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/733d8c3eb9daddddea01eb45bc5e9f432c31ee45.png)

These are examples of wrong solutions:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1f6a6f67a98ba7144b22a4396f530c0512ce6083.png)

The above solution is wrong because it doesn't use the minimum number of edges (

4

vs

3

). In addition, it also tries to construct a road between cities

1

and

3

, while the input specifies that it is not allowed to construct a road between the pair.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1682a2451ec68ed1d2f2fe67485812eff63d2055.png)

The above solution is wrong because you need to traverse at least

3

roads to go from city

1

to city

3

, whereas in your country it must be possible to go from any city to another by traversing at most

2

roads.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95923f7b5de3838c63610bd3b9015403913cbad7.png)

Finally, the above solution is wrong because it must be possible to go from any city to another, whereas it is not possible in this country to go from city

1

to

3

,

2

to

3

, and

4

to

3

.
statementZhMd:
一个国家有 $*n*$ 座城市。最初，这个国家中没有任何道路。一天，国王决定修建一些连接城市对的道路。道路可以双向通行。他希望以这样的方式修建道路，使得可以从每座城市出发，经过至多两条道路到达任意其他城市。另给定 $*m*$ 对城市，这些城市对之间不能修建道路。

你的任务是修建满足上述条件所需的最少数量的道路。题目保证一定存在满足条件的方案。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94f406a06721e89d57a14b6dfade59c6341e93e8.png)。

接下来 $*m*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$），表示城市 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和城市 $*b*_{*i*}$ 之间不能修建道路。城市编号为 1 到 $*n*$。

保证输入中每对城市最多出现一次。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $*s*$，表示需要修建的最少道路数量。接下来输出 $*s*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$），表示应在城市 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和城市 $*b*_{*i*}$ 之间修建一条道路。

如果有多个方案，输出任意一个即可。

## 说明

以下是样例的一种可能方案：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/733d8c3eb9daddddea01eb45bc5e9f432c31ee45.png)

以下是一些错误方案：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1f6a6f67a98ba7144b22a4396f530c0512ce6083.png)

上述方案错误，因为它没有使用最少数量的边（

4

条而不是

3

条）。此外，它还尝试在城市

1

和

3

之间修建道路，而输入明确规定不允许在这对城市之间修建道路。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1682a2451ec68ed1d2f2fe67485812eff63d2055.png)

上述方案错误，因为从城市

1

到城市

3

至少需要经过

3

条道路，而在这个国家中，必须能够从任意城市经过至多

2

条道路到达另一座城市。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95923f7b5de3838c63610bd3b9015403913cbad7.png)

最后，上述方案错误，因为必须能够从任意城市到达另一座城市，而在这个国家中无法从城市

1

到达城市

3

、从城市

2

到达城市

3

以及从城市

4

到达城市

3

。
